name: cGZScriptVocab_Create
notes: The script COM director's creator: a new vocabulary, not counted. Hooked (not a known function start: db/missed-functions.jsonl, CRC from hookcrc); with the terp's creator (whose constructor builds one) every vocabulary is ours. The terp's tests reach it too (its constructor's vocabulary, PushVocab). Mutants (lane MC, tools/mutate.py): the vocabulary and terp batch 40, 38 killed (three of them after the tests were strengthened: the variants left on the heap after the last Release, fake values in the first attribute, tags past 8 attributes), 2 argued equivalent (a text-mode token is only read in state kText, which treats a text token and a word alike; no entity name is 8 characters long, so < and <= the 8-character bound decide alike); the control set batch 15, all killed.
